notes: Machine-readable provenance for the provider-portability fixture corpus (issue #2123, design v3 section 16 item i). tests/unit/test_codex_body_fixtures.py is the gate; README.md renders the same facts for humans and is pinned against this file. The marker never lives inside a body: an extra top-level key makes overflow_portability_view decline with not_portable_unknown_field and would change the recorded verdict. A captured body is REBUILT from a structural allowlist rather than scrubbed, so it carries the shape of the real request (keys, discriminators, tool declaration field sets, item ids, call/output pairing) and none of its prose: every free-text field holds a synthetic placeholder derived from its own JSON path. The recorded verdict is asserted to be unchanged by that rebuild.

captured_gpt55_standard_http.json.notes: Real Codex 0.154.0 standard body. It declines even with every tool type it declares marked supported, because the real tool_search declaration carries an execution field outside _STATELESS_TOOL_DECLARATION_FIELDS, the real web_search carries external_web_access/search_content_types outside _ACCOUNT_NEUTRAL_TOOL_DECLARATION_FIELDS, and every input item carries a prefixed id so the fresh-replay predicate is false. This body therefore cannot overflow; the gate records that instead of asserting a shape no client sends. Fixing the three gaps is production work tracked separately. The prose of this body is synthetic; the shape the three reasons above depend on is the real one.

captured_gpt56sol_lite_http.json.notes: Real Codex 0.154.0 Responses-Lite body. It carries no instructions key at all, so it must be validated through normalize_responses_request_payload with openai_compat from _has_openai_responses_shape; bare ResponsesRequest.model_validate fails with 'instructions Field required'. Its additional_tools bundle declares the functions and collaboration namespaces (no web, no image_gen in this lane) and four developer prefix messages. Verdict evaluated on a view built directly from the stripped body, as the builder declines it first. The prose of this body is synthetic; the namespace/tool structure the verdict depends on is the real one.

gpt55_standard_first_turn.json.notes: Hand-written pre-strip fixture: it keeps client_metadata and stream_options on purpose, because its job is to feed strip_source_telemetry. Shape-illustrative, not byte-faithful -- compare the README divergence table against the captured pair before citing it as ground truth. Its identifiers are placeholders, so the privacy gate only exempts the bare telemetry key names.

gpt56_lite_bundle.json.notes: Hand-written pre-strip Responses-Lite fixture. Its reasoning.context decline is the one verdict the synthetic pair gets right against a real capture; its namespaces, developer prefix and empty instructions do not match Codex 0.154.0.
